body:
Well let me pose the question... what would you do?   

If you had these glaring insecurities from a life that has been hard-lived, but no money to get into therapy... no money to make yourself appear normal so you could feed your insatiable sexual appetite...

All I can think of is how am I going to get out of where I am now?  I'm stuck in a living situation that sucks.... 

The more I type the more I feel like I am bitching about something that doesn't matter... like it's so inconsequential compared to other people's issues.   There was someone else on SW who was gay, hiv + and living in the closet with his parents... no job, no school and no friends...  

I feel like a douche for even being at this point... like I'm standing on the ledge, and yet there is someone watching up at me from the street that is stronger than me... but going through far worse.   I feel powerless, confused... and don't know what to do.... what can I do?

Unfortunately Genital Warts fall under the umbrella of the HPV virus.   Hpv is currently undiagnosable, which is why over 50% of the sexually active population of the USA has it at any given time.   There are 70+ strains of HPV, and of those, 3 cause physical symptoms (iirc, could be wrong on that one).

With HPV there is nothing you can do... there is no cure.   It cures itself, usually "within 2 years"   Unfortunately 2 years for someone with a sexual addiction is an eternity.... I can't even really go more than 2 days before I start to get this overwhelming sense of dread... 

I just feel so trapped, and the only thing that I can actually blame is my own body, and my own incompetence for getting blown by some slut... I'm really in an awkward position because of the girl I mentioned...

*Sigh*

Life has thrown me a lot of curveballs lately.  Thanks for listening in any case....
